These are the slides, I gave at the International Environmental Modelling and Software Society (iEMSs) conference 2026 in Dublin, on behalf of my research collaborator [Orlando Roman](https://im.ibi.ethz.ch/en/people/scientific-assistants/orlando-roman-garcia.html). This presentation was part of the session I convened alongside Orlando and [Richard Hewitt](https://www.linkedin.com/in/richard-hewitt-09408937/): 'Synthesising advances in uncertainty exploration in land change modelling to inform planning and policy'.
